properties.name: SW USA & northern Mexico – Coccidioides (valley fever) zone
properties.note: Arizona, southern/central California, Nevada, Utah (SW), New Mexico, west Texas, northern Mexico. Small focus in Washington state not drawn.
properties.source: CDC valley fever maps; BIA2025 T2

properties.name: Ohio & Mississippi River valleys – Histoplasma
properties.note: Classic endemic area. CDC notes cases are now reported from most US states, so treat as highest-risk zone, not the only one.
properties.source: CDC histoplasmosis maps; BIA2025 6.1.9

properties.name: North-east & upper Midwest USA – Lyme disease (Ixodes scapularis)
properties.note: High-incidence states (New England incl. Maine, mid-Atlantic, Wisconsin, Minnesota). Lower risk on the Pacific coast (not drawn).
properties.source: CDC Lyme disease maps

properties.name: South-central & south-east USA, eastern Arizona – Rocky Mountain spotted fever
properties.note: Highest in Arkansas, Missouri, Oklahoma, Tennessee, North Carolina; brown-dog-tick RMSF in eastern Arizona tribal lands.
properties.source: CDC RMSF maps

properties.name: Western USA – plague & tick-borne relapsing fever foci
properties.note: Plague mainly northern New Mexico, Arizona, Colorado, California, southern Oregon, Nevada. TBRF: mountain cabins/caves.
properties.source: CDC plague & TBRF maps

properties.name: USA – local dengue transmission areas (Florida, south Texas, Hawaii)
properties.note: Sporadic locally acquired dengue. Puerto Rico and US Virgin Islands are separate entries with country-wide risk.
properties.source: CDC dengue

properties.name: Northern Botswana – malaria (Okavango, Chobe, Ngamiland)
properties.note: Namibia: Kunene, Ohangwena, Kavango, Zambezi (Caprivi), Etosha fringe. Botswana: Okavango Delta, Chobe, Ngamiland. No risk in Windhoek, Swakopmund, Gaborone.
properties.source: NaTHNaC; CDC Yellow Book

properties.name: Eastern & southern China – scrub typhus
properties.note: Summer-type foci in the south (incl. Hainan, Yunnan, Guangdong, Fujian) and autumn–winter type in the east (Shandong, Jiangsu, Henan, Anhui). Low in Tibet, Xinjiang, Qinghai, Inner Mongolia, north-east.
properties.source: Expert

properties.name: Northern & central Argentina – dengue
properties.note: Includes Buenos Aires (large outbreaks 2023–24). Patagonia and the far south: no transmission.
properties.source: NaTHNaC; PAHO

properties.name: North-east Argentina (Misiones, Corrientes) – yellow fever
properties.note: Includes Iguazú Falls area.
properties.source: CDC Yellow Book

properties.name: Southern France & Corsica – leishmaniasis, Toscana virus, Mediterranean spotted fever
properties.note: Provence, Languedoc, Cévennes, Pyrénées-Orientales, Côte d'Azur, Corsica.
properties.source: Expert; ECDC

properties.name: Spain (except Atlantic north) & Balearics – leishmaniasis, Toscana virus, Mediterranean spotted fever
properties.note: Includes Madrid region (Fuenlabrada outbreak). Galicia, Asturias, Cantabria, Basque Country lower risk.
properties.source: Expert; ECDC

properties.name: Italy (Liguria southwards, Sicily, Sardinia) – leishmaniasis, Toscana virus, Mediterranean spotted fever
properties.note: Visceral leishmaniasis is spreading into northern Italy: consider it there too.
properties.source: Expert; ECDC

properties.name: Tropical northern Australia – dengue, melioidosis, scrub typhus, JE
properties.note: Top End (Darwin), Kimberley, Cape York, north Queensland (Cairns, Townsville). Dengue mainly north Queensland.
properties.source: Expert

properties.name: Argentine Pampas (Buenos Aires, Córdoba, Santa Fe, La Pampa) – Junin virus
properties.note: Harvest season April–July.
properties.source: UKHSA HCID guidance page

properties.name: Argentina North (Salta, Jujuy) – Andes hantavirus
properties.source: UKHSA HCID guidance page

properties.name: Argentina Centro (Buenos Aires, Santa Fe, Entre Ríos) – Andes hantavirus
properties.source: UKHSA HCID guidance page

properties.name: Argentina Northeast (Misiones) – Andes hantavirus
properties.source: UKHSA HCID guidance page

properties.name: Argentine Patagonia (Neuquén, Río Negro, Chubut) – Andes hantavirus
properties.note: Epuyén outbreak 2018–19.
properties.source: UKHSA HCID guidance page

properties.name: Southern Chile (endemic in Los Lagos) – Andes hantavirus
properties.source: UKHSA HCID guidance page

properties.name: Beni department, Bolivia – Machupo virus
properties.source: UKHSA HCID guidance page

properties.name: Rural Cochabamba & La Paz, Bolivia – Chapare virus
properties.source: UKHSA HCID guidance page

properties.name: Central & north-west Bangladesh (Dhaka, Rajshahi, Rangpur) – Nipah
properties.source: UKHSA HCID guidance page

properties.name: West Bengal, India – Nipah
properties.source: UKHSA HCID guidance page

properties.name: Kerala, India – Nipah
properties.source: UKHSA HCID guidance page

properties.name: Mindanao, Philippines – Nipah / Nipah-like henipavirus
properties.source: UKHSA HCID guidance page

properties.name: Rural hills of central & eastern China – SFTS
properties.note: Season May–July.
properties.source: UKHSA HCID guidance page

properties.name: Python Cave, Maramagambo Forest (Queen Elizabeth NP), Uganda – Marburg
properties.note: Egyptian fruit bat colony.
properties.source: UKHSA HCID guidance page

properties.name: DRC 2026 Ebola (Bundibugyo) outbreak provinces
properties.note: Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, Sud-Ubangi, Nord-Ubangi. Rough outline – check alerts.
properties.source: ECDC
